meta.title: Results & analytics
meta.description: Live view of P&L, wins/losses and performance — auto-refreshed.

title: Your results
subtitle: Realized P&L, daily swings, and breakdown by pair and mode. This page refetches every five minutes and when you return to the tab.
intervalHint: Auto-refresh every 5 minutes · market prices synced on the server (Supabase cron).

kpi.totalPnlHint: Uses realized P&L from the database when present; otherwise signed trade amounts (NOK notional from fills).

charts.cumulativeHint: Running sum per trade: realized P&L when set, else signed notional (buy −, sell +) in NOK (downsampled when busy).
charts.outcomeHint: Split among trades with known realized P&L.
charts.dailyHint: Up to the last 42 days with activity. Green = up, red = down.
charts.pairsHint: Pairs with the largest contribution (positive or negative).
charts.modeHint: Paper vs live (or other modes stored on trades).

empty.needTrades: You need at least two points for the curve. Place trades or wait for closed positions with P&L.
